build_reactivemeasurements_instance: build a ReactiveMeasurements instance that emits data via reactivex Subjects for reactive subscribers
publish_datum_to_channel: publish a datum to a named channel and emit it through the reactivex Subject
capture_data_with_context_manager: capture data atomically during an act call using the capture context manager with a key
subscribe_to_datum_emissions: subscribe a callback to receive all datum emissions as channel name and datum tuples
dispose_reactivemeasurements_resources: dispose the ReactiveMeasurements instance by completing the Subject and releasing resources
